name: recovery
summary: Fleet tells you and your agents whether Claude and Codex have capacity, so work goes to a provider that answers.
day: You and your agents ask fleet providers whether Claude and Codex answer through the hub's proxy before you start work on them.
cost: One small request per provider through the hub's proxy, at most every five minutes.
risk: Low: fleet providers only reads, and spends one tiny request per provider.
